tools.name: search-endpoints
tools.description: Find Scrappa API endpoints by keyword. Returns matching endpoint names, descriptions, and parameters. Use a returned endpoint name with Call an API endpoint.

tools.name: call-endpoint
tools.description: Fetch data from a Scrappa API endpoint, including data from third-party sites. Use Find API endpoints to discover an endpoint and its parameters. Requests may use credits on your Scrappa account.

tools.name: google_maps_search_places
tools.description: Search Google Maps for businesses and places, for example "pizza in Berlin Mitte" or "dentist near Alexanderplatz". Returns public business data: name, rating, number of reviews, category, address, website, phone, coordinates and a business_id. Use the business_id with google_maps_get_reviews to rea

tools.name: google_maps_get_reviews
tools.description: Read public Google Maps reviews of one place. Needs the business_id from google_maps_search_places. Returns per review: star rating, date, review text, review language and the owner reply. By default only reviews with text are returned. Reviewer names and profiles are never returned. Reads public da

tools.name: google_flights_search
tools.description: Search public one-way flight offers on Google Flights between two airports on one date. For a round trip, search each direction separately. Returns per flight: price, airlines, flight numbers, departure and arrival times, duration and stops. It does not book or buy anything. Reads public data only.

tools.name: youtube_get_transcript
tools.description: Get the public transcript (captions) of a YouTube video. Accepts a video URL or video id. Returns English when available, otherwise the video language, unless you ask for a language. Returns the language and the full transcript text, cut at 40,000 characters for very long videos. Reads public data o

tools.name: trustpilot_get_company_reviews
tools.description: Read the public Trustpilot rating and reviews of a company by its website domain, e.g. "zalando.de". Returns the TrustScore, star rating, total review count and per review: rating, title, text, date and the company reply. Reviewer names and profiles are never returned. Reads public data only.

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Search Google and get the organic web results for a query. Returns per result: position, title, link and snippet. Use it for current information from the web. Reads public data only.

tools.name: geizhals_search_products
tools.description: Search the Geizhals price comparison (Germany, Austria, EU) by keyword, e.g. "samsung 990 pro 2tb". Returns per product: product_id, name, manufacturer, all-time lowest and highest best price, user rating, test score, key specifications and the Geizhals link. Use geizhals_get_product with a product_

tools.name: geizhals_get_product
tools.description: Get one Geizhals product by its product_id (from geizhals_search_products or a Geizhals link like "...-a2795961.html"). Returns the best and average price, the number of offers, current shop offers (shop, price, availability, shipping), full specifications, test review scores and the Geizhals link.

tools.name: geizhals_get_price_history
tools.description: Get the best-price history of one Geizhals product by its product_id. Returns the current best price, the all-time lowest and highest best price, and the dates on which the best price changed within the chosen window (each entry is valid until the next one). Reads public data only.
